# Generated upb accessors for the four OTLP trace proto files.
#
# These files are generated by ci/scripts/regen-protos.sh using
# protoc v29.4 + protoc-gen-upb/protoc-gen-upb_minitable from the
# same upstream pin. CI verifies zero-diff on every PR (ci.yml,
# job: regen-check).
#
# DO NOT edit files under gen/ by hand — run regen-protos.sh instead.

add_library(microtel_upb_gen STATIC
    opentelemetry/proto/common/v1/common.upb.c
    opentelemetry/proto/common/v1/common.upb_minitable.c
    opentelemetry/proto/resource/v1/resource.upb.c
    opentelemetry/proto/resource/v1/resource.upb_minitable.c
    opentelemetry/proto/trace/v1/trace.upb.c
    opentelemetry/proto/trace/v1/trace.upb_minitable.c
    opentelemetry/proto/collector/trace/v1/trace_service.upb.c
    opentelemetry/proto/collector/trace/v1/trace_service.upb_minitable.c)

# Generated headers use:
#   #include "opentelemetry/proto/.../foo.upb.h"  — resolved from gen/
#   #include "upb/..."                             — resolved from upb runtime
#   #include "upb/port/def.inc"                   — same
target_include_directories(microtel_upb_gen
    PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

target_link_libraries(microtel_upb_gen PUBLIC microtel_upb_runtime)

# Generated C is compiled as C11.
target_compile_features(microtel_upb_gen PUBLIC c_std_11)

# Suppress warnings in generated code.
target_compile_options(microtel_upb_gen PRIVATE -w)
